subtitle: Build evaluation skills from the ground up.

tracks.foundation: Inside the model: maths, activations and how data moves through the network. Branch spurs under Data literacy and Deep learning cover trees, rewards and GANs.
tracks.llm-systems: Outside the model: prompts, generation behavior, retrieval and scoring answers with evidence. Upcoming craft lessons cover metrics, human review, error analysis and reports.
tracks.systems-production: Further out: the eval harness, automation and shipping with measurable quality. Upcoming ops lessons cover monitoring, canaries and SLOs.
